newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Aug real retail sales rise 2.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Aug real retail sales rise 2.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Slovak August retail sales rose, in real terms, by 2.4 percent after rising a real 5.5 percent in July, the Slovak Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
SUSR added retail sales for the first eight months of 1996 totalled 187.1 billion crowns, a rise of 6.7 percent over the first eight months of the previous year.
SLOVAK RETAIL SALES Aug '96 July '96 Aug '95
Note. SUSR said the figures are preliminary and still subject to revision.
